# Savorka Solar

> Savorka Solar is one of India's fastest-growing renewable energy companies, founded in 2016. Headquartered in India and operating across 8 states, Savorka delivers high-performance On-Grid, Off-Grid, and Hybrid solar systems for residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale projects. With 150+ MWp of installed capacity, 70+ trusted clients, and in-house solar structure manufacturing capabilities, Savorka provides end-to-end solar services — from engineering and installation to operations & maintenance (O&M).

## About

- [Home](https://www.savorka.in/): Overview of Savorka Solar's capabilities, key stats (150+ MWp, 8 states, 70+ clients), solar system types offered, and approach to long-term energy reliability.
- [About Us](https://www.savorka.in/about): Company history (founded 2016), mission, engineering philosophy, quality standards, and the team behind Savorka's precision-driven solar installations.

## Services

- [All Services](https://www.savorka.in/services): Full overview of Savorka Solar's service portfolio — from rooftop and ground-mounted solar to structure manufacturing and O&M.
- [Residential Solar](https://www.savorka.in/services/residential): Cost-effective on-grid and hybrid rooftop solar solutions for homeowners, designed to reduce electricity bills, enable net metering, and deliver long-term ROI.
- [Commercial & Industrial Solar](https://www.savorka.in/services/commercial-industrial-solar): High-capacity solar systems engineered for commercial buildings, factories, and industrial facilities — optimized for maximum energy yield and operational cost reduction.
- [Ground Mounted Solar](https://www.savorka.in/services/ground-mounted-solar): Large-scale ground-mounted solar installations for utility-scale and open-land projects, with optimal tilt, orientation, and tracking for maximum generation efficiency.
- [Solar Structure Manufacturing](https://www.savorka.in/services/solar-structure-manufacturing): In-house manufacturing of durable, precision-engineered solar mounting structures for both rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects across India.

## Blog & Resources

- [Blog](https://www.savorka.in/blogs): Educational articles and guides on solar energy, system types, ROI, and industry insights for homeowners, businesses, and developers.
- [On-Grid vs Off-Grid Solar System](https://www.savorka.in/blogs/on-grid-vs-off-grid-solar-system): A detailed comparison of on-grid (grid-tied) and off-grid solar systems — covering how they work, costs, benefits, and which system suits different energy needs.
- [Ground Mounted vs Rooftop Solar: ROI](https://www.savorka.in/blogs/ground-mounted-vs-rooftop-solar-roi): An analysis comparing the return on investment of ground-mounted and rooftop solar systems, helping clients choose the right installation type for their situation.
